---
title: National Ice Services and Data Products
date: last-modified
---

emacs | Ice center / service                                              | Primary geographic coverage (operational focus)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **U.S. National Ice Center (USNIC)**                              | **Global** ice/snow products; routinely organized around **Arctic, Antarctic, Great Lakes, and U.S. Mid-Atlantic** product families. ([usicecenter.gov][1])                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Canadian Ice Service (CIS)**                                    | **Canada’s navigable waters** (national mission), with operational charting cadence varying by activity level (e.g., daily in active areas, weekly elsewhere). ([e-navigation.canada.ca][2])                                                                                                                                      |
| **International Ice Patrol (IIP, USCG)**                          | **North Atlantic iceberg hazard**; Area of Responsibility centered on the **Grand Banks of Newfoundland** (iceberg monitoring/warnings for trans-Atlantic shipping lanes). ([Navigation Center][3])                                                                                                                               |
| **Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) – Greenland Ice Service** | **Greenland waters**, with a core mapped area around **Cape Farewell** (south Greenland) and seasonal expansion northward as needed.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **MET Norway – Ice Service**                                      | Arctic operational charting with strong focus on **Svalbard/Barents region**; in Copernicus operational context, coverage includes **Baffin Bay, Greenland Sea, Fram Strait, and Barents Sea**. ([data.marine.copernicus.eu][4])                                                                                                  |
| **Finnish Ice Service (FMI)**                                     | **Baltic Sea system** (whole-basin ice charting) and adjacent areas; described as covering the Baltic east of 9°E plus **Skagerrak and Swedish Kattegat** (and certain lakes) in the referenced WMO compendium.                                                                                                                   |
| **Swedish Ice Service (SMHI)**                                    | **Baltic Sea region** ice conditions (operational service remit). ([SMHI][5])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **German Ice Service (BSH)**                                      | **Baltic Sea + German Bight (North Sea)**; the referenced WMO compendium specifies separate chart products for the **Baltic Sea (north/east sectors)** and for **western Baltic/German Bight**.                                                                                                                                   |
| **Icelandic Meteorological Office / Iceland sea-ice charts**      | **Waters around Iceland**, with chart coverage described as variable within **~65–69°N and 11–28°W**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Arctic & Antarctic Research Institute (AARI, Russia)**          | Broad operational scope across **Eurasian Arctic** plus additional basins; the referenced compendium notes routine products for the **Arctic Ocean**, plus charts for **Gulf of Finland, Caspian, Okhotsk, Bering, Tatar Strait**, and also Antarctic support charts.                                                             |
| **Japan (operational drift-ice/sea-ice services)**                | Operational emphasis on **Sea of Okhotsk / Hokkaido drift ice** (a long-standing national operational focus area). ([Earth-graphy][6])                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Argentina – Naval Hydrographic Service (SHN)**                  | **NAVAREA VI**: **Antarctic Peninsula, Bellingshausen Sea, Weddell Sea, and the Southwestern Atlantic**, including iceberg drift products for wider NAVAREA VI. ([Frontiers][7])                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Chile – Armada / DIRECTEMAR (ice limits/charts)**               | Operational ice information products used for **Antarctic passages and adjacent Southern Ocean areas** (e.g., Antarctic Peninsula transit corridors). ([Directemar][8])                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Australia – Bureau of Meteorology (BoM)**                       | Operational marine responsibility aligned to **METAREA X** (South Indian + South Pacific/Southern Ocean sector defined by WMO), with Antarctic/Southern Ocean services including sea-ice mapping products. ([WWMIWS][9])                                                                                                          |
| **South African Weather Service (SAWS)**                          | Operational marine warning/forecast responsibility aligned to **METAREA VII** (SAWS marine service area). Ice-specific charting is less consistently documented publicly than the centers above, but this is the standard MSI coverage frame used operationally.                                                                  |
| **North American Ice Service (NAIS) – coordination construct**    | A **binational coordination** construct (commonly CIS + USNIC) used to harmonize North American ice analysis and dissemination; in practice, it aligns to **Arctic/sub-Arctic North American waters** and their approaches (e.g., Baffin Bay/Davis Strait/Greenland vicinity appear in routine synopses). ([usicecenter.gov][10]) |
| **Poland (IMGW marine/ice information)**                          | Operational focus on **Polish Baltic Sea coastal waters** and ports during the ice season (national service functions via IMGW). ([Baltyk][11])                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **United Kingdom – British Antarctic Survey (BAS)**               | BAS is an IICWG participant primarily as an **Antarctic operational/science support** organization; its practical geographic focus is **Antarctica/Southern Ocean**.                                                                                                                                                              |
